gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds) prints five fund columns; detail has only the General, Street and Lottery budgetary comparison schedules, whose receipt actuals equal those columns (6,886,704 + 1,617,961 + 1,524,768 = 10,029,433). The Debt Service Fund and Community Development Fund columns have no schedule. Debt Service Fund: Property taxes 900,746 + Intergovernmental 72,270 + Investment income 22,051 = 995,067; Community Development Fund: Investment income 24,596 + Miscellaneous 89,279 = 113,875. Added = 1,108,942. Check: 10,029,433 + 1,108,942 = 11,138,375 = statement Total Receipts.
